title: the waveform keeps the cumbia, then one thin line
story: Acaríñame is a cumbia at 83 BPM, slow in the outro: the bass wave rises a step per bar (0.26 to 0.42), the bright stabs flash the colour on the hit and fall back, and the 8th guacharaca strokes thicken the line. Every two beats the wave's length steps by 0.15. At 6177 the chord rings out: the amplitude follows the RMS down to silence, the line stretches, the colour drains to 0.6 and the picture is one thin line at the end.
